verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own SDK documents downloading models to the device, with detailed progress events, and running them on-device and offline. However, nothing in the evidence says those models come from Hugging Face or that users can pull arbitrary open models from there. missing for 10: any documented Hugging Face integration or repo/model-id download, support for arbitrary open-model choice and formats, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: `download` returns a stream of `DownloadEvent`. Models are hundreds of megabytes to several gigabytes, so show this rather than a spinner.
The RunAnywhere Kotlin SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device.
When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
